sections.Profile:
The "Harley-Davidson" pinball machine, originally released by Sega in September 1999 and later continued by Stern Pinball, is notable for being the last machine produced under the Sega brand. Designed by Jon Borg and Lonnie D. Ropp, it features authentic Harley-Davidson engine sounds and a variety of engaging gameplay elements.

- Manufacturer: Stern Pinball Inc.
- Years made: 1999–2002
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
